newsitem.title: ITALY: Albanian PM to meet EU foreign ministers.
newsitem.headline: Albanian PM to meet EU foreign ministers.

text.p: Albanian Prime Minister Bashkim Fino will meet European Union foreign ministers in Rome next Tuesday, the Italian Foreign Ministry said on Thursday.
The meeting, requested by Fino, will come the day after EU foreign ministers go to Brussels to hear from an EU fact-finding mission sent to Albania earlier this week to assess the situation there.
The foreign ministers are due in Rome on Tuesday for celebrations to mark the 40th anniversary of the signing of the Treaty of Rome, which founded the six-nation European Economic Community (EEC).
A Foreign Ministry spokesman said full details of Fino's visit still had to be worked out.

Fino wants an international peacekeeping force to be sent to Albania to help to restore law and order after weeks of civil unrest, but the EU indicated it would not back any large-scale military intervention.

The head of the EU mission, Dutch diplomat Jan de Marchant et d'Ansembourg, told a news conference in the Netherlands on his return from Tirana that Europe should send a "modest police presence" to the Balkan state.
Fino, who heads an all-party government set up to organise elections by June, has also called for urgent EU financial aid.
